headline: Of 10 runs on Oct 1, 4 completed, 3 failed and 2 were cancelled; one is still running. The implement workflow produced most of the failures.
observations: 44% of runs completed (57% if cancelled runs are left out). Three of the four completed runs recorded an outcome of succeeded.
Two of the three failures happened in implement: a gate that timed out after 120000 ms, and a record script that exited 1.
One cancelled run carries a script error from its load node, so it is a failure in practice.
Spend is $5.00, and $2.00 (40%) went to a run that failed.

recommendations.action: Raise the gate node's 120000 ms timeout in the implement workflow, or make its checks faster.
recommendations.reasoning: The gate failed by running out of time, not by finding a problem, so the work it checked may have been fine. The timeout is set in the workflow, so the fix belongs there rather than in an instruction file.
recommendations.evidence: One implement run failed with 'Timed out: gate' after 120000 ms.
pros: Stops a run being thrown away by a limit rather than a real failure.
cons: One run is too few to know the limit is the cause; a hung check would also take longer to fail.

recommendations.action: Look at why run r10 is still marked running.
recommendations.reasoning: A run that stays running with no activity holds its worktree and hides whether it failed. Finding why it stopped reporting comes before any fix.
recommendations.evidence: Run r10 is unfinished, with no activity for a long time.
pros: Frees the run's worktree and shows its real outcome.
cons: It is one run; the cause may be a one-off crash with nothing to change.

failure_notes.Timed out: gate: The gate script ran past its 120000 ms limit. Check whether the limit is too short for the checks it runs.
failure_notes.Workspace setup failed: The run never started because git could not create its worktree. This is an infrastructure fault, not a workflow defect.
failure_notes.Script failed: record: The record script exited with code 1 after the work finished; read the node output for the reason.

version_note: Archon went from 0.11.1 to 0.12.1 at 12:45 UTC. Six runs started on 0.11.1 and four on 0.12.1, which is too few on either side to say the upgrade changed the success rate.
